newsitem.title: USA: US jet dives on inventory-driven NYMEX selloff.
newsitem.headline: US jet dives on inventory-driven NYMEX selloff.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices dove at least two cents Wednesday amid a NYMEX selloff triggered by new inventory data showing a solid distillate gain in the fuel-strapped Northeast, players said.

But differentials on aviation-quality 54-grade fuel held steady in both centers as November NYMEX fell 2.20 cents a gallon following API weekly data showing a 2.5 million barrel distillate build on the East Coast for the prior week.
The report also showed record distillate output of over 3.60 million barrels per day. "I like to see that. We'll benefit from that as end-users," one Gulf Coast buyer said.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk 212 859-1632
